citation: Pavicic et al. J Drugs Dermatol. 2011;10(9):990–1000.
ingredient_form: EVETIS product presence: Hyaluronic Acid (SP-TS-9). The study abstract discusses HA/hyaluronan; it does not establish the precise commercial INCI salt or equivalence to this toner.
support_summary: A randomized vehicle-controlled topical study in 76 women tested HA formulations at several molecular weights and found improved skin hydration versus vehicle. This supports the modest general ingredient hydration meaning.
limitations: Cream formulations tested, not EVETIS toner.
No verified molecular-weight equivalence to EVETIS; no claim of clinically proven product efficacy.
No transfer of anti-wrinkle, elasticity, dosing, timing, numerical outcomes or safety claims.
Does not establish that HA causes the buyer’s perceived softness.
owner_authority: Owner Decisions — Phase 3.1B Expertise Approval, У1 conditional approval, 2026-10-04

authoritative_form_specific_support.document: Revision of European Ecolabel Criteria for Cosmetic Products — preliminary report
authoritative_form_specific_support.support_summary: Table 41 lists Hyaluronic Acid separately from Sodium Hyaluronate among ingredients with humectant function in skin-care formulations. Ingredient function support, not an approval or efficacy trial of EVETIS.
